description: We’re students at the Muhammad al-Khwarizmi IT school in Tashkent who like building things that mix code and hardware. We work in C++, C#, Python, Java and SQL, plus Unity, FlutterFlow, Arduino and Blender. Our projects include Bytez, an eco app/game with 3D worlds for Technovation Girls, and a climate control system with sensors, C++ firmware and a 3D-printed case. We’ve done hackathons together, so we know how to ship something that works under a tight deadline.
